spec2def(riched32.dll riched32.spec)

# riched32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/riched32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(riched32_shims OBJECT richedit.c)
target_link_libraries(riched32_shims PRIVATE wine libriched20 libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(riched32_shims)
add_cargo_module(riched32 riched32-cargo riched32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS riched32_shims psdk)
